testcase.name: Scenario: Apply Reset Ribbon after confirming: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-appearance-source/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:211:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply Reset Ribbon after confirming ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active with the full Tools ribbon selected in the MCAD Software ✔ And Team Web is disabled while Tutorials and User Commands are enabled in Show Panels ✔ When the user right-clicks the Options panel title ✔ And the user opens Ribbon Appearance ✔ And the user selects Reset Ribbon ✔ Then a confirmation says ribbon customizations will be removed ✔ And the confirmation offers Yes and No ✔ When the user selects Yes ✔ Then the confirmation closes ✔ And the 3D Model tab becomes active with its full command groups ✔ When the user selects Tools ✔ Then the Tools ribbon displays its standard groups with Team Web visible and Tutorials and User Commands hidden ✔ And the part remains visible
